metadata.title: Differentiability of Lipschitz mappings into metric spaces: area and co-area formulas
metadata.abstract: We give a self-contained exposition of metric differentiability for Lipschitz mappings from sets in Euclidean spaces into arbitrary metric spaces, together with the corresponding area and co-area formulas. The novelty is a new metric implicit function theorem for mappings into metric spaces, which is then used to give a direct and geometric proof of the co-area formula for Lipschitz mappings into metric spaces.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 系统阐述欧氏域到任意度量空间 Lipschitz 映射的可微性、面积与余面积公式，并提出度量隐函数定理。
analysis.breakthrough: 为余面积公式提供直接几何证明。
analysis.limitations: 需区分综述部分与新隐函数定理，检查秩和测度的约定。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
analysis.aiEvidence: 正文与致谢披露大模型反复帮助识别数学错误和排版错误；文稿主体在生成式 AI 广泛使用前已写成。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.09121v1（AI 声明/致谢；涉及摘要者同时核对元数据）
analysis.priorityReason: 非光滑分析基础工具，适合作为共读资源。
